method: Primary manufacturer pages read for the listed facts. No hands-on tests, checkout tests, measured efficiency or universal phone compatibility claims.

products.note: Correct URL discovered from the official Xiaomi power-bank range; the shorter /xiaomi-power-bank-4i-20000mah/ redirects to an error page.
